resolved.title: IN 条件操作符
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The IN Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]IN [/b]operator is used when you want to compare a column with more than one value. 

For example, you might need to select all customers from New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago.
[s0l0!-header]With the [b]OR [/b]condition, your SQL would look like this:[/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" codeId="3047"]SELECT * FROM customers 
WHERE City = 'New York'[b]
OR[/b] City = 'Los Angeles'
[b]OR[/b] City = 'Chicago';[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2816" width="100%"]
[note]The IN operator is used when you want to compare a column with more than one value. [/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The IN Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

[s0l0!-header]With the [b]OR [/b]condition, your SQL would look like this:[/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" codeId="3047"]SELECT * FROM customers 
WHERE City = 'New York'[b]
OR[/b] City = 'Los Angeles'
[b]OR[/b] City = 'Chicago';[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2816" width="100%"]

content.text:
当你想判断某个字段的值是否在特定到多个值中时，可以使用**IN**操作符。

例如，你可能需要查询所有来自纽约`'New York'`、洛杉矶'`Los Angeles`'和芝加哥`'Chicago'`的客户。

如果使用**OR**条件，SQL语句类似：
content.text_html:
The **IN **operator is used when you want to compare a column with more than one value.

For example, you might need to select all customers from New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago. With the **OR **condition, your SQL would look like this:

当你想用一个以上的值来比较一列时，可以使用**IN **操作器。

例如，你可能需要选择所有来自纽约、洛杉矶和芝加哥的客户。 使用**OR **条件，你的SQL语句会是这样的。

content.content:
SELECT * FROM customers 
WHERE City = 'New York'
OR City = 'Los Angeles'
OR City = 'Chicago';

[s0l0!-header][h1]The IN Operator [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You can achieve the same result with a single IN condition, instead of the multiple [b]OR[/b] conditions: [code format="sql" codeId="3048"]SELECT * FROM customers 
WHERE City [b]IN ('New York', 'Los Angeles', 'Chicago')[/b];[/code]

resolved.title: 联赛球队名单
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设有一张各联赛足球队表**teams**，数据如下：

![](/content/assets/209fbffb5f71a114fdc7.jpeg)

列字段含义:
- `teamname`: 队名
- `county`: 所在国家

写一个查询，输出国家在`Spain`、 `England` 或 `Germany` 的球队名及国家名。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The IN Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are sorting football teams by leagues and given the following table named [b]teams[/b]. [img id="4536" width="100%"]Write a query to output the team names and the countries of all teams that have played in La Liga (Spain), Premier League (England) and Bundesliga (Germany)․
[note]Use the [b]IN [/b]operator.[/note]

code_templates.prepend_code:
CREATE TABLE teams (
  id int,
  teamname VARCHAR(128),
  country VARCHAR(128)
);

INSERT INTO teams (id,teamname,country)
VALUES
(1,'FC Barcelona','Spain'),
(2,'FC Bayern Munich','Germany'),
(3,'FC Chelsea','England'),
(4,'FC Roma','Italy'),
(5,'FC Leon','France'),
(6,'FC Ajax','Nederland');

resolved.title: NOT IN 条件操作符
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The NOT IN Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]NOT IN[/b] operator allows you to exclude a list of specific values from the result set. 

If we add the [b]NOT [/b]keyword before [b]IN [/b]in our previous query, customers living in those cities will be excluded:[code format="sql" ]SELECT * FROM customers 
WHERE City [b]NOT IN[/b] ('New York', 'Los Angeles', 'Chicago');[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2817" width="100%"]
[note]The NOT IN operator allows you to exclude a list of specific values from the result set. [/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The NOT IN Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]NOT IN[/b] operator allows you to exclude a list of specific values from the result set. 

If we add the [b]NOT [/b]keyword before [b]IN [/b]in our previous query, customers living in those cities will be excluded:[code format="sql" ]SELECT * FROM customers 
WHERE City [b]NOT IN[/b] ('New York', 'Los Angeles', 'Chicago');[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2817" width="100%"]
[note]The NOT IN operator allows you to exclude a list of specific values from the result set. [/note]

content.text:
**NOT IN**操作符允许你从结果集中排除一系列特定的值。

如果我们在之前的sql中**IN**关键字前面添加**NOT**关键字，那么居住在这些城市的客户将被排除在外：
content.text_html:
The NOT IN operator allows you to exclude a list of specific values from the result set.

If we add the **NOT **keyword before **IN **in our previous query, customers living in those cities will be excluded:

**NOT IN*操作符允许你从结果集中排除一系列特定的值。

如果我们在之前的查询中，在IN之前添加NOT关键字，那么居住在这些城市的客户将被排除在外。

content.content:
SELECT * FROM customers 
WHERE City NOT IN ('New York', 'Los Angeles', 'Chicago');

content.text: **NOT IN**操作符允许你从结果集中排除一系列特定的值。
content.text_html:
The NOT IN operator allows you to exclude a list of specific values from the result set.

NOT IN操作符允许你从结果集中排除一个特定的值的列表。
